metadata.question: Is the forest loss from 2015 to 2022 larger than that from 2000 to 2015 at Macaya National Park?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use WDPA polygons to find Macaya National Park in Haiti by name, then use Hansen Global Forest Change v1.10 (2022) image to assess loss. Periods: 2001–2015 vs 2016–2022 within park boundary.
2. Masking strategy: Hansen dataset (no cloud masking). Define baseline forest as treecover2000 > 30% and land via datamask.
3. Logic: Compute loss areas (m²/ha) for both periods. Validate with counts and null checks. If no geometry or no valid pixels -> C1/C2. If numbers null/NaN -> C3. Compare P2>P1 -> A else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const wdpa = ee.FeatureCollection('WCMC/WDPA/current/polygons');
    // Try to find Macaya National Park by name within Haiti; fall back to broader search if needed
    let fc = wdpa
      .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ISO3', 'HTI'))
      .filter(ee.Filter.or(
        ee.Filter.stringContains('NAME', 'Macaya'),
        ee.Filter.stringContains('ORIG_NAME', 'Macaya')
      ));
    let size = await fc.size().getInfo();
    if (size === 0) {
      fc = wdpa.filter(ee.Filter.or(
        ee.Filter.stringContains('NAME', 'Macaya'),
        ee.Filter.stringContains('ORIG_NAME', 'Macaya')
      ));
      size = await fc.size().getInfo();
    }
    if (size === 0) {
      console.log('Macaya geometry not found in WDPA.');
      console.log('C1');
      return;
    }
    const geom = fc.geometry().dissolve(1);
    const parkArea_km2 = await ee.Number(geom.area(1)).divide(1e6).getInfo();
    console.log(`Macaya features: ${size}; Area (km²): ${parkArea_km2.toFixed(2)}`);

    // 2. Data Acquisition
    const gfc = ee.Image('UMD/hansen/global_forest_change_2022_v1_10');
    const tree2000 = gfc.select('treecover2000');
    const lossyear = gfc.select('lossyear');
    const datamask = gfc.select('datamask'); // 1 = land
    // Forest baseline mask (>30% canopy in 2000, on land)
    const forestMask = tree2000.gt(30).and(datamask.eq(1));

    // Periods: P1 = 2001-2015 (lossyear 1..15), P2 = 2016-2022 (16..22)
    const lossP1 = lossyear.gte(1).and(lossyear.lte(15));
    const lossP2 = lossyear.gte(16).and(lossyear.lte(22));

    const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().rename('area');
    const forestAreaImg = areaImg.updateMask(forestMask);
    const loss1AreaImg = areaImg.updateMask(forestMask.and(lossP1));
    const loss2AreaImg = areaImg.updateMask(forestMask.and(lossP2));

    // 3. Processing and Validation
    const reducers = ee.Reducer.sum().combine({reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true});
    const scale = 1000; // per instruction to avoid timeouts
    const maxPixels = 1e13;

    const forestStats = await forestAreaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: reducers, geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels, tileScale: 4
    }).getInfo();
    const loss1Stats = await loss1AreaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: reducers, geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels, tileScale: 4
    }).getInfo();
    const loss2Stats = await loss2AreaImg.reduceRegion({
      reducer: reducers, geometry: geom, scale: scale, maxPixels: maxPixels, tileScale: 4
    }).getInfo();

    const forest_m2 = forestStats ? forestStats['area_sum'] : null;
    const forest_count = forestStats ? forestStats['area_count'] : null;
    const loss1_m2 = loss1Stats ? loss1Stats['area_sum'] : null;
    const loss2_m2 = loss2Stats ? loss2Stats['area_sum'] : null;

    if (forest_count === 0 || forest_m2 === 0) {
      console.log('No valid forest pixels after masking (treecover2000>30% & land).');
      console.log('C2');
      return;
    }
    const vals = [forest_m2, loss1_m2, loss2_m2];
    if (vals.some(v => v === null || v === undefined || isNaN(v))) {
      console.log('Calculation returned null/NaN.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    if (forest_m2 < 0 || loss1_m2 < 0 || loss2_m2 < 0) {
      console.log('Invalid negative area encountered.');
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }

    const forest_ha = forest_m2 / 1e4;
    const loss1_ha = loss1_m2 / 1e4;
    const loss2_ha = loss2_m2 / 1e4;
    const p1_pct = (loss1_m2 / forest_m2) * 100.0;
    const p2_pct = (loss2_m2 / forest_m2) * 100.0;

    // 4. Print concise evidence (<=20 lines total)
    console.log(`Forest2000 (>30%) area (ha): ${forest_ha.toFixed(1)}; valid cells: ${forest_count}`);
    console.log(`Loss 2001–2015 (ha): ${loss1_ha.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Loss 2016–2022 (ha): ${loss2_ha.toFixed(1)}`);
    console.log(`Share lost P1 (% of 2000 forest): ${p1_pct.toFixed(2)}%`);
    console.log(`Share lost P2 (% of 2000 forest): ${p2_pct.toFixed(2)}%`);
    const comparison = loss2_m2 > loss1_m2;
    console.log(`Is 2016–2022 loss > 2001–2015 loss? ${comparison ? 'Yes' : 'No'}`);

    // 5. Final Answer
    console.log(comparison ? 'A' : 'B');
  } catch (err) {
    console.log(`Error: ${err}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
